title: Paul's Treehouse
author: Gene Wolfe
note: conf=0.95; Standalone short story (1969), first published in Orbit 5, ed. Damon Knight. Collected in Gene Wolfe's Book of Days (1981) and Castle of Days (1992); these are collections, not a series to which the story belongs. ISFDB lists no series affiliation for the title. This ebook is a single-story file with no ISBN.
